title: Lamoille Valley Bike Tours

services.name: Ebike Tours
services.desc: Available year round Thursday-Sat & Sundays in October! (November-May with ADVANCED RESERVATION) ​Beer and Bikes, two of man's greatest inventions! We bring the two together with an adventure ebike tour that includes stops at FOUR local, yet national breweries, Rock Art Brewery, Lost Nation Brewery, Soulmate Brewing Company and Ten Bends Beer, all from the seat of your electric bike! This tour combines the best of our scenic tours and is almost exclusively on the Lamoille Valley Rail Trail. Vermont is well known as the craft brew capital of the country.
